What am I looking at?

Same hill, two addresses. The WEB copy puts the Dollar Mill entrance hill where the road really is; the DEV copy still has it at the old spot ~1,300 u east / 2,300 u south. Each pane's roads are drawn the way that copy's game draws them — laid over its own ground — so in WEB the Dollar Mill road climbs the entrance hill, while in DEV the same road runs flat there and climbs a phantom hill on Fulton Industrial Boulevard instead. The red tint marks where the two grounds disagree.
